title: Declared IaC configuration evidence (outputs/iac-config-evidence.json)
description: ADR-0010 task V04, contract iac-config-evidence. Static rule hits over Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, Kubernetes manifests and Dockerfiles. Declared configuration only: nothing here observes cloud, cluster, registry or runtime state. There is no tool message, title, remediation or snippet field (scanner messages embed resource values); a hit is a rule identity, a closed category, a resource address and a location. Cross-record rules are enforced by appsec-review-process/secrets_iac_contracts.py.

attempt_id.description: The NODE attempt that published this document.

source_snapshot_sha256.description: Intake source-snapshot identity; must equal the one in tool-results.json and coverage.json.

redactor.description: Identity of the publication-boundary redactor. A copy for readers: it must equal the redactor block of outputs/redaction-receipt.json, which evidence_redaction.verify_receipt pins to the running module.

rule_hits.description: May be empty, and is empty for a SKIPPED node. An empty list is not evidence of absence.
